dslRule:
<!id: annotationmodel.fixModificationStampLeak>
<!description: Prevents AnnotationModel.fModificationStamp from leaking AnnotationModelEvent objects by replacing the direct assignment of the event object with a new generic Object.>
<!severity: ERROR>
<!tags: bugfix, eclipse, jface>

fModificationStamp = $event; :: instanceof($event, "org.eclipse.jface.text.source.AnnotationModelEvent") && inClass("org.eclipse.jface.text.source.AnnotationModel")
=>
fModificationStamp = new java.lang.Object();
;;
summary: Replaces assignment of AnnotationModelEvent to fModificationStamp with new Object() to prevent memory leak.
